##  FLT3-Conserve

**Sequence conservation analysis of FLT3 across species.**

FLT3-Conserve is a bioinformatics project developed to practice biological sequence analysis, Python programming, data handling and visualization.

### Skills demonstrated

- Python
- Biopython
- Sequence analysis
- Multiple-species comparison
- Data visualization
- Git & GitHub
